title: Insurance fee for declared value
body:
We want to offer insurance on shipments with a declared value.

Add `insurance_fee(declared_value, zone)` to `parcelo/rates.py`. The fee is 2% of the declared value plus the zone's fuel surcharge percentage of the declared value, with a minimum fee of 1.00. The fuel surcharge percentages are the same ones `fuel_surcharge` in `parcelo/legacy/billing.py` already uses.

An unknown zone must fail. A declared value that is zero or negative must fail too.
